newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street stocks seen opening lower.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street stocks seen opening lower.

text.p: Wall Street stocks are expected to open lower on Monday as the market enters another week fraught with anxiety over interest rates.
Comments by investment guru Warren Buffet that stocks were overvalued would weigh on markets on Monday along with anticipation of Wednesday consumer price data, analysts said.
"We are looking at a market that will probably have a lower opening," said Peter Cardillo, director of research at Westfalia Investments.
